text: Institution specific automatic triggers in contingent capital securities are flexible and can be tailored to the parties' needs precisely because they operate independently of regulatory discretion.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857

isBasedOn.name: Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry

abstract: Because institution-specific automatic triggers are independent from regulatory discretion, they have the advantage of being flexible and can be tailored to the parties' respective needs.

value: triggers are privately negotiated and automatic
